detail.longDescription: Gemini CLI -> Antigravity CLI (agy) migration, checked against Google's docs: • GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md keep working • Project skills move to .agents/skills • MCP servers move to mcp_config.json, and remote url/httpUrl becomes serverUrl • Extensions: agy plugin import gemini • Loose .toml commands: free MIT script converts them to SKILL.md (dry run by default, never overwrites) https:// agentkitco.com/blog/migrate-ge mini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/ # GeminiCLI # Antigravity # AIagents
